newsitem.title: CHINA: China interbank market rates (CHIBOR) mostly up.
newsitem.headline: China interbank market rates (CHIBOR) mostly up.

text.p: Following is the China Interbank Offered Rate (CHIBOR) for Thursday issued by the official Xinhua news agency on behalf of the People's Bank of China, the central bank.
The figures represent weighted averages and not closing prices and are annual percentage rates.
Turnover rose to 2.468 billion yuan from 1.481 billion yuan with the 60-day contract the most actively traded.
Traders said trading was more active than Wednesday with short-term financing centres, money brokerages run by the central bank, trading actively.

With the approach of the summer grain harvest season, more institutions were borrowing money from the short-term financing centres to cover fund shortages for buying grain, pushing the centres to borrow more on the interbank market, they said.
The centres from the grain-producing provinces of Hunan and Henan were the most active net borrowers today, traders said.
Traders said they believed the rates would move around the current level in the next few days.
